secrets.name: LOVABLE_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for Lovable's AI gateway (ai.gateway.lovable.dev) — powers chat, image generation, and voice features. Obtain from the Lovable dashboard / project settings.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key — bypasses RLS for server-side admin operations. Obtain from Supabase dashboard → Settings → API → service_role key.

secrets.name: OAUTH_STATE_SECRET
secrets.description: Random secret used to HMAC-sign OAuth state tokens. Any long random string works.

secrets.name: APP_USER_CONNECTION_KEY_SECRET
secrets.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte key for AES-256-GCM encryption of user connection keys. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth client ID for connector integrations. Obtain from Google Cloud Console → Credentials.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Google OAuth client secret for connector integrations. Obtain from Google Cloud Console → Credentials.
